recognize_zh: 積液細胞抹片中是大型、核不規則且染色質粗、細胞質深藍的淋巴瘤細胞；流式與免疫染色支持 T 細胞表型，TRG 基因重組呈單株峰，但 IGH (FR3) 也出現單一峰，這是「假單株」結果，不可據此判為 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular/lobated nuclei, coarse chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm among red cells
Panels B-C: flow cytometry dot plots with distinct colored populations (axis labels not legible)
Panel D: IHC with membranous/cytoplasmic granular staining of most large cells (marker unlabeled)
Panel E: strong nuclear staining in most tumor cells (marker unlabeled; pattern fits a high proliferation or transcription marker)
Panel F: IHC essentially negative except rare cells (marker unlabeled)
Panels G-H: capillary electrophoresis showing a dominant TRG peak and a single dominant IGH FR3 peak
describe_en: Cytologic preparation of the effusion shows large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Flow cytometry plots and immunostains (markers not labeled/legible in the figure) characterize the population, with one marker diffusely positive, one showing nuclear positivity in most cells and one negative. Fragment analysis demonstrates a dominant TRG peak as well as a dominant IGH FR3 peak. In context, findings are consistent with a T-cell lymphoma presenting as a primary effusion-based lymphoma, with the IGH peak representing a pseudo-monoclonal result (limited template or cross-lineage rearrangement) that should not override the immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Classic PEL is HHV8/LANA positive with plasmablastic null-cell phenotype and true IG rearrangement, rather than a T-cell phenotype.
This entity expresses B-cell markers (CD20/PAX5) with clonal IG rearrangement that is reproducible, not pseudo-clonal.

ddx.dx: Secondary effusion involvement by systemic PTCL
ddx.vs: Distinguished clinically and radiologically by a nodal or extranodal mass outside the serous cavity.
